title: Surgical cost-probe suite and staged rollback orchestrator for batching/cache recommendations
creator: Asha Patel
description: Objective: Build a targeted, low-risk experiment and rollback system that safely applies batching/cache recommendations and detects quality regressions before user-facing impact. This ticket delivers: (1) a "surgical probe" test harness that runs narrow micro-canary experiments per route/model variant, (2) a statistical regression detector tuned for small-sample delta sensitivity, (3) an orchestrator that performs staged applies with automatically-triggered rollback when acceptance thresholds fail. Scope excludes UI work in Console (separate PM ticket) and large-scale autoscaling changes.
acceptance_criteria:
- Probe harness executes per-route micro-canaries in shadow and 1% live cohorts without adding latency to baseline routes.
- Regression detector flags quality drops with false positive rate <= 2% on internal held-out corpora.
- Staged apply flow supports 0% -> 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic hold or rollback based on configured thresholds.
- Every apply generates a human-readable report (delta in key metrics, anchor examples) and a link to failed golden prompts.
- Integration test coverage for detector and rollback orchestrator with synthetic and replayed traffic.
- Runbook documented and run in a tabletop exercise with SRE and PM teams.
design_decisions:
1) Use route-level surgical probes instead of broad canaries to limit blast radius; probes sample 200-2k requests per route depending on traffic.
2) Metric set: anchor-adjusted metric deltas (perplexity delta where available, top-k accuracy for classification tasks, semantic similarity with embed-based scoring for open generation).
3) Statistical test: bootstrap-based nonparametric confidence intervals + Bayesian sequential testing to make early stop decisions on small samples.
4) Golden prompt corpus: persisted seed of 1k anchors stratified by route, with per-customer and cross-customer slices for high-value routes.
5) Rollback trigger: signal combination of (quality delta exceeding threshold) OR (user-facing error rate spike) OR (rate-limited latency SLO degradation).
6) Shadow mode default: new configs run in shadow for 48h before any live percent ramp unless manually overridden.
implementation_plan:
Phase 1 (2 weeks): implement probe harness and collector, wire into existing telemetry cluster; add golden prompt storage and retrieval.
Phase 2 (2 weeks): implement regression detector and dashboard metrics; expose thresholds as config.
Phase 3 (1 week): implement staged apply orchestrator with percent ramps and rollback webhooks; add GitHub PR automation for config changes.
Phase 4 (1 week): integration tests, tabletop runbook, and initial small-scale pilot on 3 low-risk routes.
Owner: Diego Martinez; Pair: Lina Chen (statistics). Key libs: existing telemetry, kafka-based eventing, python eval harness repo (github.com/redwood-inference/eval-harness).
testing_plan:
- Unit tests for detector logic with controlled synthetic deltas.
- Replay tests: run past 48h traffic through probe harness and compare detector outputs to known signals.
- A/B tests: start 0%->1% micro-canary for two weeks on low-impact route; manually verify anchor examples with PM.
- Stress test: ensure probe collector does not increase tail latency beyond 5ms per request.
- Fault injection: simulate partial telemetry loss and verify orchestrator fails safe (holds and notifies).
rollback_runbook:
1) Automated rollback conditions evaluated at each ramp step. If triggered: orchestrator halts ramp, immediately rolls cohort back to last stable percentage, and notifies SRE/owner.
2) If automated rollback fails (e.g., API unreachable), escalation to on-call SRE.
3) Post-rollback: orchestrator creates incident with initial triage checklist and attaches failing golden prompts + metric deltas.
4) Manual rollback from Console: disabled until 48h shadow unless PR explicitly marks urgency.
5) Recovery path: revert config commit via CI/CD and run a confirmatory probe to ensure stable quality restored.
monitoring_and_alerting:
- Primary alerts: quality-delta > configured threshold for more than 10 consecutive samples; high-severity SLO breaches.
- Secondary alerts: probe failure rate > 1% of expected probes/day; latency tail increase > 10% during probe window.
- Dashboards: per-route delta chart, rolling CI band, top 20 failing golden prompts, recent rollbacks list.
- Pager routing: SRE on-call if automated rollback triggers for >2 high-traffic routes in 24h; otherwise notifies owner and PM.

notes: Avoid coupling to global config updater until rollback hooks are idempotent. Consider adding a lightweight human-in-the-loop approval gate for enterprise tenants with high SLAs. Follow-on tickets: add Console UX for one-click abort and post-mortem artifacts export.
